messages:
Leah (PM): small heads-up: planned release v1.9.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. primaries: infra perf tweaks + model pin shuffle. Need: internal RN draft, short customer blurb, pin owner, and confirmation on EU embargo/legal ok. aiming to post internal announce after signoff. cc @here :calendar:

Mikko (Eng): canary plan: 8% traffic for 25m in us-west-2 then promote if metrics stable. rollback triggers: errors >1.5% sustained 5m OR p95 latency > 40% above baseline. will attach exact thresholds to the deploy config.

Jae (Docs): I can draft both internal and public lines. For customers: "v1.9.0: infra & stability improvements; no API changes". Internal RN will list infra changelog + rollout plan + pin rationale.

Omar (Legal): quick note: any messaging mentioning "data residency" or EU-specific behavior needs signoff. If RN is generic (no residency claims) we don't need extra review. please flag if there are regional notes.

Leah (PM): we do have EU region-specific pin (we pin to v1.8.x in eu-west-1 for now). Omar: want legal to glance at internal blurb but public blurb should be fine as-is.

Tess (Ops): Ops will own the pin during rollout. Tess confirms pin ownership. Rationale: rolling infra-level changes that might affect edge routing. Ops will also run final smoke at T-10m.

Kai (Oncall): Kai and Devon on watch. Runbook: http://go/runbooks/release-rollout. Will monitor redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, system.mem.rss.

Mikko (Eng): deploy command queued below. will start canary at 09:05 PT.

```
/deploy release/v1.9.0 --canary=8% --duration=25m --region=us-west-2 --notes="pin:ops"
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy 6c7d8e. scheduled start 16:05 UTC. monitors: redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, system.mem.rss.

deploy-bot: canary started at 16:05 UTC. reporting window open.

Kai (Oncall): initial metrics look good; p95 within baseline, errors 0.2%. continuing to watch.

deploy-bot: canary complete at 16:30 UTC  preliminary metrics OK. awaiting owner promotion.

Tess (Ops): ops gives go for promote. no veto. promoting to 100% in 5m.

deploy-bot: promoted to 100% at 16:36 UTC. release tag v1.9.0. summary: p95 -2% vs baseline, errors 0.25%. :tada:

Jae (Docs): draft RN posted in this thread for signoff: "v1.9.0 — infra performance and model pin consolidation. No API changes. Ops owned rollout; EU region remains pinned to v1.8.x pending further compatibility testing. No customer-impacting issues observed during canary."

Omar (Legal): skimmed RN; public blurb ok. internal note mentions EU pin which is fine. no further legal action.

Leah (PM): pin owner (Tess) confirmed, legal noted, RN approved. Jae will post internal announce in #eng-all and we send customer blurb in the morning. Closing thread once announces are up.

Jae (Docs): posted internal announce at 17:02 UTC in #eng-all and scheduled the customer blurb for 09:00 PT. closing thread now."
